title: Mushroom Pesto Quinotto
ingredients: TO SERVE: large handful of basil leaves, Parmesan cheese grated (optional)
method: Spray a sauté pan or nonstick flameproof casserole dish (with a lid) with oil and fry the onion and mushrooms gently for 8 minutes. Add the garlic and stir through, then add the quinoa.

Pour 500ml (18fl oz) of the hot stock into the pan and allow to simmer gently for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Now pour in the remaining stock, bring up to a fast simmer and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the peas and courgette, season with salt and pepper and simmer for 5 more minutes.
Remove from the heat and stir through the pesto. Place the lid on the pan and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Serve with plenty of basil leaves and cheese, if you like.
notes: For vegetarian, look out for vegetarian red pesto (many contain non-vegetarian cheese) and a Parmesan-style vegetarian cheese to grate over the top.
